msg: ADR 0026 P6 read-side seam: (1) fix at storePaths/loadTics, not in 'log' — all 15 readers (inbox, board, claim-check, claim-owner, gate, cycle) go through it; P6 test pins log AND claim-check (gate-critical: guard-edit-scope calls claim-check/claim-owner on every edit). (2) reads never mutate the bus checkout: union of working-tree tics.d (local incl. unpushed) + the fetched remote-tracking tree (git ls-tree/cat-file of origin/<branch>), dedup by filename — no rebase/checkout on read (races emits, index lock). (3) fetch is throttled, never per hook call: TICS_FETCH_TTL (default 60 s) via a stamp in TICS_GIT_DIR; 'tics sync' / 'tics log --fetch' force; short network timeout; any fetch failure is silent and reads local (offline exit 0). (4) views show freshness: 'bus as of <last fetch>' on log/board. Pin (2) and (3) in red: a read leaves HEAD/index/worktree of the bus checkout unchanged; a second read inside the TTL does no network (assert stamp unchanged).
